snippet.title: Demonschool - Official Release Date Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Demonschool is a new-style tactics RPG where motion equals action. Take the fight to big weirdos between the human and demon worlds as Faye and her misfit companions, all while navigating university life on a mysterious island. Demonschool will be released on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Switch, and PC on November 19, 2025.
